title: Unbreakable
problem: Flat extra −50% whatever the Class Strength value (even 0), for any creature with an Artifact; community_vet_B6 confirms.
notes: In-game test:  Fix: H | 2026-10-26 realign (text is the contract): text claims "Class Strength Artifact properties prevent 50% more damage from that class". H: Unbreakable (bc_EventDamage L1816-L1844): +50% of the creature's Class Strength property for the attacker's class instead of a flat extra 50%. vs bugged: weaker (no flat 50% with 0 Class Strength). | In-game test: Unbreakable with an Artifact without a Class Strength property: no extra reduction; with a property: its reduction grows by 50% against that class only.

release_notes.intended: Your creatures' Class Strength Artifact properties prevent 50% more damage from that class.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, any creature with an Artifact got a flat extra 50% reduction, with or without a Class Strength property.
release_notes.fix: Now the bonus raises the Class Strength property's own reduction by 50%, against that class only.
